paragraphs.text: The following Bloomburrow characters are only mentioned in flavor text or on legendary creature cards, appear as minor characters in the storyline , or are otherwise not notable enough to receive their own article.
Blor , called Blor the Impervious , is a frogfolk warrior known for their boastfulness and invulnerability. Blor speaks in the third person .
Olinda , called Olinda the Oblivious , is a skunkfolk who is oblivious to her own smell.
